## Plan

1. `inference/materialize.py` `read_predicate_reconciliation` — rewrite resolved query: join current resolutions (`upper_inf(r.sys_period)`, `winning_claim` set) → winning `claim wc` restricted to tier-0 + current + `claim_eligible_sql` (degraded when the disposition registry is absent) AND subject ∈ claimed set (numerator ⊆ denominator by join). Partition the claimed set into numerator + exclusions {conflicted (current envelope, no winner), withheld (winner fails eligibility), non_publishable (winner fails tier-0/currency), filtered (no current resolution envelope)}. Emit per-predicate `{claimed, resolved, exclusions{...}}`; internal assert |D| = N + ΣE.
2. `coverage_record` schema — new sqitch change `coverage_exclusion_disclosure`: `exclusions jsonb` (additive) + CHECK `numerator + not_evaluable = denominator` scoped to `metric_method='reconciliation_ratio'`.
3. `metric_row`/`_insert_coverage`/`read_materialized_coverage` — carry `exclusions`; `not_evaluable` = Σexcluded for ratio rows; digest covers exclusions.
4. `exports/spine_export.py` `coverage_metric_from_materialized` — emit `exclusions` + `excluded_total`; N-of-N impossible by construction when excluded > 0.
5. `exports/analytics.py` `_provenance` — `surfaces.dossiers` map keyed by `jurisdiction_slug(group.jurisdiction)`; each summary scoped to weight rows whose claim_id ∈ the group's sites' `claim_ids`; `artifact_count` = distinct artifacts via `evidence_bindings`; denominator names the dossier scope; `human_review_status: unreviewed` (per-dossier review posture unknown → honest).
6. `web/src/lib/data.ts` `getDossierProvenance(slug)` — export mode reads `surfaces.dossiers[slug]`, undefined when absent (honest fallback); fixtures → undefined.
7. `web/src/pages/dossier/[slug].astro` — pass `provenance={getDossierProvenance(dossier.slug)}` + `provenanceName`; BaseLayout comment tightened (fallback is now the honest site-wide path — scope label always names the actual data source).
8. `web/scripts/build-fixture-export.ts` — fixture `surfaces.dossiers` map so e2e renders per-dossier provenance.
